insect; six-legged arthropod in ordinary usage
energy; capacity to produce physical change
language; structured human/animal/artificial system of meaningful signs
intelligence; capacity to learn, reason, generalize and solve problems

added.originalGloss: space; spatial extent; extension independent of location
added.reason: pago lists "space" among its synonyms in the sense of a location. Qualified to extent, as the candidate's own scope directs ("Distinguish physical extent from pago place").

added.gloss: maturity; being fully developed or adult
strike; impact; physical blow/contact with force
extinction of a species; the dying out of a kind of life
added.reason: Bare "extinction" is already the gloss of faruna (faru.negative), which is a fire going out. Qualified so the two senses stay apart.
Proposed gloss said "predatory aggression" while its own scope says it is "NOT always predation". Narrowed; predation proper needs no new word.
Proposed gloss said "plant species" while its own scope restricts it to "Flowering plant type specifically; not all plants". Narrowed to match the folni component.
Proposed gloss said "steel tool" while its own scope says it "does NOT always imply steel". Narrowed to the material the components actually name (germa, metal).
Proposed gloss said "chorus" while its own scope says it is "NOT necessarily repeated refrain". Narrowed so it does not shadow ralelirapatu.

added.gloss: plot of a story; narrative line
added.reason: Bare "plot" is a synonym of silrolordi, "conspiracy; secret plan". Qualified to the narrative sense.

added.gloss: surplus; quantity beyond what is needed
added.reason: pari already means gain/profit and lists "surplus" among its synonyms. Qualified to quantity-in-excess, which profit does not cover.
